profile.description: S.C. Romcarbon S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a plastic processor in Romania, Europe, China, Israel, Taiwan, and Panama. The company offers air, cabin, fuel, and oil filters; granular and powder active carbon; basic foil, folded sheet for packing and thermo shrinkable covers, general use polyethylene film, constructions film, black film for mulch, premium UV solar 3 year film, transparent film for the plant germination, UV Solar, coated/uncoated polypropylene fabric, PP strap, thick and thin sacks and bags, uncoated polypropylene bags, one and two loop big bag, polypropylene coated bags, polypropylene bags with PE liner, and four loop big bag; and extruded PS standard and absorbant tray, food packaging, and PET rigid packaging. It also provides XPS panel/insulation underlament; Q-Bag, PP threads, yarn, and fabric; polypropylene bags with valve and strapping tape; recycled polymers rPP, rPE, rPS, and rABS, as well as plastic compounds; bio compostable shopping bag, bio compostable vegetable bag/fruit bag, recyclable waste collection bag, and bio compostable bag for organic waste; PVC support for road sign; and PP straps. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of plumbing, heat, and air conditioning installation; business and other management consultancy, other information technology and computer service, sport facilities, and other financial service activities; manufacture of products for the human health. Its products are used for agriculture, automotive, construction and home improvement, filtration and protection masks, slaughterhouse and food processing, horeca, packaging, plastic processing, and printing house applications. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Buzau, Romania.
